text: Osvaldo Fattoruso, born on 12 May 1948 and passing away on 29 July 2012 at the age of 64, was a Uruguayan musician. He played a key role in introducing rock music to Latin America through his band Los Shakers and is known for creating a fusion of jazz, rock, and African rhythms. Fattoruso is buried at the Cementerio del Norte in Montevideo. He was the brother of Hugo Fattoruso and Sylvia Veronica Fattoruso. This article on a Uruguayan musician is a stub.
